label: SIMPLY_PRIOR_1: PriorSimply y x: y is prior to x simply, not in time: whatever is in potency in a…
definition: `PriorSimply y x`: y is prior to x simply, not in time: whatever is in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect, because potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. It is a dependence relation distinct from present moving. Whether simple priority makes y a cause of x's being is not part of this definition: that is the open premise STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING. In Lean PriorSimply is a primitive relation with no body: the gloss above is carried only by the premise ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading (a constraining premise, not the linked relation projection), which constrains it; it is not a definitional equation.
note: Primitive boundary: the linked declaration projects an independently supplied binary relation on beings from PriorityFrame Being Respect; it is not a definition by temporal, causal or perfection data. See docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md, Priority semantic linkage audit, for interpretation, dependency boundaries, examples, exclusions and OPEN structural constraints. No statement meaning or frozen Challenge changes.

formal_gap.meaning: PriorityFrame.PriorSimply y x says that y is prior to x simply, not in time: x depends on y in the order of actuality, as whatever is in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect (ST I q.3 a.1). It is a supplied binary relation on beings; the gloss is carried by the premise ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading, which constrains it, not by a definitional equation.
examples: An actual agent relative to a capacity it actualizes, such as fire relative to wood that is able to be hot (an intended example; its applicability is open).
exclusions: Being earlier in time (PriorInTime): a merely earlier event is not sufficient.
Present moving (MovesIn): simple priority is a dependence relation distinct from moving.
Causing the being of x (CausesIn at esse): the passage is the open premise STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (DISAMB-CAUSE).
Priority in substance (PriorInSubstance): passes to simple priority only by an explicit hypothesis (DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME).
open_obligations: STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY (ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading) is the open premise that supplies its use.
Transitivity, asymmetry and well-foundedness are not imposed; what dependence consists in beyond the supplied relation is OPEN.
Coverage and exclusivity of the three priority senses (STMT-PRIOR-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE, STMT-PRIOR-SENSE-UNIQUE) remain open frontier premises.

Not a formalization candidate from existing vocabulary: defining it as 'y is in act where x is in potency' would make STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY nearly analytic and conceal the dependence it asserts.
